description: Non-material amendment to the planning permission reference: 2024/02201/FUL dated 24th September 2025 for the "Redevelopment of the site to include, change of use of the existing property from a school (Class F1) to a mixed use (Class E) at basement and ground floor level and conversion of first, second, third and fourth floor level into 7no. self-contained flats (Class C3); alterations to include, removal of existing fire escape staircase to the rear of the building, erection of a three storey extension with an undercroft below and a roof terrace above; addition of rear metal balconies/terraces at first, second and third floor level; installation of 2no. air source heat pumps, metal door, decking, balustrade, steps, cycle gutter, and roller shutter to the rear ground floor elevation, creation of residential entrance to the front elevation, and erection of 1.8m high security gate in connection with the formation of a gated side access for cycle parking, cycle and bin stores at ground floor level; associated alterations." Amendment sought to the wording of Condition 21 relating to the permitted operating hours for a future Class E(d) (indoor sport, recreation or fitness) use.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - No customers shall be present within the commercial premises at basement and ground floor level between the hours of 23:00 and 06:30 on any day, including Public and Bank Holidays, except where otherwise specified below.

Where the premises are operating as a Class E(b) use (sale of food and drink for consumption mostly on the premises), no customers shall be present between the hours of 23:30 and 07:30 on any day, including Public and Bank Holidays.

Where the premises are operating as a Class E(d) use (indoor sport, recreation or fitness), no classes shall take place between the hours of 21:00 and 06:30 on any day. No customers shall be present between the hours of 23:30 and 06:30 on any day, including Public and Bank Holidays. Between the hours of 06:30 and 07:30, the Class E(d) use shall operate only in accordance with the approved Noise Management Plan.

Where the premises are operating as a Class E(f) use (creche, day nursery or day centre), no pupils or staff shall be present between the hours of 19:30 and 07:30 on any day, including Public and Bank Holidays.

To safeguard the amenities of occupiers of the development and surrounding properties from noise and disturbance associated with activities taking place at, arriving at, or departing from the site, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 2 - The use of the commercial premises must be operated in strict accordance with the Noise Management Plan prepared by Metropolis Planning, Ref: 3467, dated Sep 2026. 

To protect the amenity of nearby residents and the local community from adverse noise impact and to ensure the safe and acceptable operation of the premises in line with Policies CC10, CC11, CC13, T1 and T3 of the Local Plan (2018).
